SIP::to
       Returns the value of the To header in a SIP request.

SYNOPSIS
       SIP::to

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the value of the To header in a SIP request.

       Syntax

       SIP::to

	    * Returns the value of the To header in a SIP request.

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when SIP_REQUEST {
	    log local0.info "[SIP::to]"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.2.0 --First introduced the command.
